name: r1-c-e3-l2ring-b
author: solx-loop
description: (H10) At L, fp32 h written to a per-CTA two-slot ring (2 x 148 x 256 KB = 76 MB) with st.global.L2::cache_hint evict_last is re-read from L2 one round later by the same CTA. Only the 512-float GRN statistics cross CTAs, and the per-batch wait hides behind the next round's GEMM1. Estimate per 128-token round: GEMM1 epilogue about 10k clk with 6.1k clk of MMA under it, GEMM2 about 7k clk; about 14 us at 1.5 GHz, so about 150 us portal and 115 us rented at 64,56,56. UNVERIFIED: never compiled or ru
